**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)

**Title (Pali):** Sabbamatthītikathā

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sabbamatthītikathā* ("Discussion of 'Everything Exists'") is the sixth debate of the first book or chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, located in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Watanabe 1983]. Within the dialectical structure of the *Kathāvatthu*, it represents a formal Sthaviravādin refutation of the core proposition maintained by the Sarvāstivāda school that past, present, and future dharmas exist (*sabbam atthi*), using systematic logical methods of interrogative refutation [Watanabe 1983; Kragh 2013]. Modern scholarship has analyzed the text as a central Theravādin critique of Sarvāstivādin ontological and temporal theories [Kragh 2013].
